values.note: 70 tent/RV sites in the A and B areas (36 take an RV, 34 are tent-only), plus 20 lean-tos and 5 cabins. Ten RV sites list 28-35 ft (2, 3, 4, 5, 12, 29, 30, 32, 35, 39, all in the A area); the other 26 list 20 ft.

hookups.source: vtstateparks-visit.com parkId 1280078 site list (every campsite typed 'Campsite Tent/RV' or 'Campsite Tent Only', no electric or water types; only the cabins are 'Cabin Electric'), read 2026-11-16

note: Two wooded camping areas on peninsulas of Waterbury Reservoir, with campers' beaches, a campers' boat launch and boat rentals. Sites 51 and 52 sit at a fenced bluff over the water but are 20-ft sites; the longer sites are in the western part of the A area. --Claude

Season stored manual 05-15/10-22 vs RA 2027 05-21..last night 10-16 -> flag 05-21/10-17. Phone null -> 802-244-7103. Website OK. Not waterfront kept (T51/T52 bluff with filtered view, 20 ft). Pin at the park office ~390 m west of the camping-area centre.
flags: SEASON (manual, not overwritten): stored 05-15/10-22 ('Third weekend in May through the Third weekend in October'). The park page still says that, but RA's 2027 Park Season is 'Fri May 21 2027' to 'Sat Oct 16 2027' (last night) -> proposed 05-21/10-17. 10-22 is wrong for 2027 either way (third Saturday of October 2027 is the 16th). Page adds: 'As of Monday, September 7, the B-side is closed' (stored season note covers it).
PHONE: stored null -> 802-244-7103 (park page 'Phone 802-244-7103'; Map & Guide '(802) 244-7103 (Operating Season)').
WEBSITE: both lines live and correct (https://www.vtstateparks.com/parks/little-river 200; RA parkId 1280078 serves the site list). No change.

PIN: stored 44.3898,-72.7673 is the park office/entrance at the west end. The tent/RV sites run ~750 m east along the A-area peninsula (to the beach and boat launch ~44.3910,-72.7577) with the B area ~450 m north-east. Proposed centre: ~44.3898,-72.7624 (A-area road at the neck between the western loops, sites 2-30, and the eastern peninsula, sites 32-58) - a ~390 m move; approximate, placed from the Map & Guide against imagery since RA has no GIS for Vermont.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): Map & Guide marks 'Steep bank/Cliffs' along the A-area shore; RA photos of T51 and T52 (20 ft, nightly) show a fenced bluff edge with the reservoir glimpsed through trees; T02-T05 and T15/T16/T41 photos show forest only. 2024-06-01 imagery is continuous canopy over every site. At most a filtered view from two 20-ft sites a 23-ft rig can't use -> not waterfront stands. The campers' beaches are separate swim areas.
SITES: stored sites/hookups/facilities were empty; now written from the park page, Map & Guide and RA. Inclusion evidence ('36 Tent/RV sites, lengths to 35 ft, RV dump station') is accurate.
ALERTS: no bridge or road limit. 'Current timeline places [reservoir] drawdown starting no earlier than 2028' (Waterbury Dam Spillway Project) - not yet a closure; worth watching.
